data.long_meaning: Shivin is a Hindu name that means 'God of Destruction and Regeneration'. This name is derived from the name of the Hindu deity Shiva, who is the god of destruction, regeneration, and transformation. Shiva is also known as the god of time, as well as the god of dance, music, and arts. In Hindu mythology, Shiva is depicted as having three eyes and a third eye on his forehead, which represents wisdom and the ability to see the past, present, and future.
